name: Babice nad Svitavou (Czechia)
description: Blue field with a yellow triangle issuing from the hoist edge reaching two thirds of the flag's length, bearing a blue cross.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 25 November 2003 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
